|Canadian asset manager RBC Global Asset Management (RBC GAM) has acquired Australian active fund manager Yarra Capital Management, which specialises in fixed income, equities and alternatives.

|Private credit funds continue to lag in improving poor disclosure, distribution and conflict-management practices since ASIC handed down its scathing inaugural report into the opaque sector 12 months ago.

|MLC Expand's new private equity owner is helping the platform leverage its US network to fast-track its AI capabilities, chief executive Liz McCarthy said.

|ETF Shares has listed a new exchange traded fund (ETF) dedicated to data centre infrastructure, giving investors exposure to companies supporting the physical expansion of artificial intelligence (AI).
